title: Tier-aware SLO config schema (Hosted/Dedicated) + validation + examples
author: Aisha Bello
description: Context: As part of ENG-2417 (Tiered SLO definitions + error budget policy), we need a single canonical config shape that expresses SLOs per tier (Hosted vs Dedicated), across common Redwood indicators (availability, timeouts, streaming disconnects, latency) while keeping measurement windows/filters consistent and enforceable by downstream tooling (budget calculators, dashboards, release gates). This PR introduces a tier-aware SLO config schema in slo-toolkit, adds strict validation (with actionable error messages), and includes runnable examples + unit tests. What’s included: (1) New schema module for TieredSLOConfig with explicit tier dimension and tier-specific allowed SLIs (Dedicated additionally supports pool readiness / capacity SLIs). (2) Validation rules to prevent common footguns: missing tier, invalid SLI names, inconsistent window definitions, cardinality explosion via unrestricted labels, and conflicting route selectors. (3) Examples for Hosted API (chat streaming + embeddings) and Dedicated (inference endpoints + pool readiness) with comments aligned to current SRE definitions. (4) Docs update describing the schema, versioning strategy, and how downstream consumers should interpret filters (tier/region/model/route). (5) Test suite covering positive/negative cases + snapshot of validation errors to keep messaging stable. Non-goals: This does not change budget computation logic (PR #118) beyond accepting the new config shape; it only ensures config is validated and normalized before consumption. Follow-ups: Wire this schema into control plane config ingestion and canary/release gates (ENG-2422/ENG-2427).
commits: schema: add Tier enum and base SLOConfig types
validation: add normalize+validate pipeline w/ error codes
docs: add tier-aware schema reference + examples
tests: add golden tests for validation messages and sample configs
illustrative_snippet:
Example config (Hosted / chat streaming):

apiVersion: slo.redwood.ai/v1alpha
kind: TieredSLOConfig
metadata:
  name: hosted-chat-streaming
spec:
  tier: hosted
  service: api-gateway
  indicator:
    type: availability
    mode: request
    successCondition:
      httpStatusClasses: ["2xx"]
    failureCondition:
      httpStatusClasses: ["5xx"]
      timeoutClassifications: ["server_timeout"]
      streamingDisconnectClassifications: ["server_disconnect"]
  objective:
    target: "99.90%"
    window: "30d"
  filters:
    regions: ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
    routes: ["/v1/chat/completions:stream"]
    models: ["*"]
    customerScopes: ["shared"]
  labels:
    owner: "eng-sre"
    runbook: "https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/error-budget-exhaustion"

Example validation error:
- E_CFG_014: Dedicated tier requires indicator.type in {availability, latency, pool_readiness}; got 'streaming_disconnect_rate'. Use indicator.type=availability with streamingDisconnectClassifications instead.
review_conversation: Rafael Mendes (review): Can we enforce a hard ban on free-form label selectors? Last time we let teams pass arbitrary labels we blew up cardinality in dashboards. Aisha Bello (author): Added allowlist validation: filters only accept regions/routes/models/customerScopes; arbitrary metric labels are rejected unless they are in spec.allowedMetricLabels. Also added docs guidance + default allowlist (tier, region, route, model, status_class) and a guardrail error E_CFG_021. Allison Grant (review): Please align window parsing with org standard: allow 7d/30d but reject mixed units like '4w'. Also, objectives should require window >= 7d. Aisha Bello (author): Updated window parser; now accepts {1h, 6h, 1d, 7d, 30d} explicitly. Added rule that objectives must be 7d or 30d for tiered SLOs (error E_CFG_005). Jordan Lee (review): Downstream policy engine needs stable identifiers. Please include spec.id (string) or derive a deterministic key; also ensure metadata.name is not used as identifier. Aisha Bello (author): Added optional spec.id. If missing, we derive configKey = sha256(tier|service|indicator|filters) and emit in normalize(); docs updated to recommend setting spec.id for human readability. Thomas Baird (review): The models: ["*"] wildcard is fine, but we should warn if models contains > N entries to avoid per-model explosion. Aisha Bello (author): Implemented warning W_CFG_003 if models list > 25. Validation does not fail, but normalize() emits a warnings array (currently surfaced via return type). Also added tests. Rafael Mendes (follow-up): warnings array changes public API; is that safe? Aisha Bello (author): Kept backwards compatible by returning {config, errors, warnings} from validateTieredConfig(); existing callers (none outside toolkit today) use only errors. Added CHANGELOG note under 'Added'. Approvals: Rafael ✅, Allison ✅, Jordan ✅. Squash merge after CI green.
release_notes: Added TieredSLOConfig schema (v1alpha) with Hosted/Dedicated variants, validation + normalization helpers, and example configs for Hosted streaming/embeddings and Dedicated inference/pool readiness.
